criteria.note: Independently re-attacked check_spec lane logic with 18 fixtures OUTSIDE the repo (scratchpad). All hold with zero mismatches: lane planned without plan and/or without work is red; standalone with plan and/or work is red; unknown value is red; empty-string and whitespace-only lane are red (not silently treated as absent); absent lane stays green (back-compat, confirmed further by the 4 pre-existing specs WARP-0100/0101/0113/0114 that carry no lane and still pass validate.py all); planned with both present is green. No silent acceptance of any inconsistent lane. The 6 selftest cases exist and pass within 63/0.

Reproduced the half-promotion negative myself: baseline validate.py all is green; flipping WARP-0102 work W2 -> W3 makes validate.py all exit 1 with BOTH mirroring errors (plan-side: PLAN-0001 says WARP-0102 must declare work W2; spec-side: plan work W3 is spec WARP-0103, not WARP-0102); git checkout restores to exit 0. Matches negative-tests.txt exactly. Tree left clean.

All three verbs exercised live against PLAN-0001. status: 1/12 shipped, frontier WARP-0102/0104/0105/0106/0108 - byte-matches specs/index.md. release-check exits 1 naming all 11 unshipped work items and the D1 block. impact WARP-0105 = [WARP-0107, WARP-0112] (hand-verified transitive); impact WARP-0101 set = {0102,0104,0103,0111,0112} (hand-verified). impact on a spec not in the plan (WARP-9999) errors cleanly (exit 1, no traceback). Built temp plans outside the repo to reach paths the live plan cannot: release-check reports releasable only when all work is shipped, journeys present, no blocking decision, milestone named, and flips to NOT releasable on each condition removed; the impact already-shipped-dependent WARNING branch fires. item_state unit cases (4) cover the state logic. NOTE: plan.py reads spec statuses ROOT-relative (specs/*.md of the live repo), so a copied plan's shipped-ness can only be steered by referencing specs that are/aren't shipped in this repo, not by editing spec files in a temp dir - inherent, not a defect.

SKILL.md documents all seven verbs (create, refine, approve, pull, revise-with-impact, status, release) plus the two-lane/promotion boundary; revise cites python3 .warp/plan.py impact. specs/TEMPLATE.md carries the lane field (line 9). capabilities.yaml: plan_dialogue=procedure, plan_lane_fields=mechanical, plan_ops=mechanical, plan_run_integration=absent (W3). plugin/templates copies are byte-identical to the live .warp files (plan.py, validate.py, capabilities.yaml, TEMPLATE.md). The run-time context bundle is deferred by omission (never claimed as a verb). See finding F1 for the one prose overclaim about the run-skill refusal.

findings.text: SKILL.md pull section (line 39) states 'Do not pull a work item whose dependencies are unshipped; the run skill will refuse it anyway.' The run-skill unshipped-dependency refusal is W3 and capabilities.yaml correctly marks plan_run_integration as absent ('unshipped-dependency refusal at run time is W3'). Presenting the refusal as an already-active safety net, with no W3/not-yet caveat, is a soft overclaim - by the capability manifest's own rule ('a claim in prose that contradicts a status here is a documentation bug') it is a doc bug. Non-blocking: the source of truth (capabilities.yaml) is honest, no false-green gate results, and the run-time context bundle itself is correctly deferred by omission. Suggest rewording to 'the run skill will refuse it once run integration lands (W3)' or dropping the clause.

plan.py verbs are advisory: release-check exits non-zero and the skill instructs setting status: released only on a releasable result, but nothing in scripts/verify.sh calls plan.py, so plan_ops is not gate-enforced. Labeling it 'mechanical' is consistent with the manifest's existing usage for other non-gate-wired shipped code (e.g. plan_index / update_index.py), so this is a terminology observation, not a defect; AC3 requires only that the verbs exist, be derived, be exercised, and be unit-tested for state logic - all met.

summary: Independent rerun and adversarial re-test of WARP-0102 on commit e79a545. All three required reruns reproduce: selftest 63 passed / 0 failed, validate.py all exit 0, verify.sh GATE GREEN (5 run, 0 undeclared). All four acceptance criteria confirmed against fresh evidence I generated (18 out-of-repo lane fixtures with zero mismatches, self-reproduced AC2 half-promotion both directions, live and temp-dir plan.py exercise covering the releasable path and the shipped-dependent WARNING, hand-verified transitive impact). One note-level finding: SKILL.md line 39 presents the W3 run-skill dependency refusal as if already active. No blocking findings; the change satisfies its specification. Tree left clean (only gate churn .warp/events.jsonl and .warp/last_verify, plus untracked proof/WARP-0102/).
